name: Wirtshaus zum Griena
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Griena Inn in Tirol** --- **

Welcome to the heart of the Alps

** Nestled in the breathtaking landscapes of **Tirol**, the **Wirtshaus zum Griena** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a rustic yet cozy setting. Whether you're seeking a hearty meal, a cold drink after a day of hiking, or simply a place to unwind with stunning mountain views, this historic inn is your perfect retreat. --- **

Tradition meets modern comfort

** Since its founding in the 19th century, the **Wirtshaus zum Griena** has been a beloved gathering spot for locals and travelers alike. Today, it blends time-honored traditions with modern comforts, offering you the best of both worlds. The warm, wooden interiors and crackling fireplaces create an atmosphere that feels like home—no matter where you come from. --- **

A culinary journey through Tirol

** Indulge in our carefully crafted menu, featuring classic Tyrolean dishes that will tantalize your taste buds. Start with a bowl of creamy **Käsespätzle**, followed by a sizzling **Schweinsbraten** with dumplings and sauerkraut. For dessert, treat yourself to a fluffy **Kaiserschmarrn**, dusted with powdered sugar and served with fresh fruit compote. Our selection of local beers, crisp **Tiroler Apfelwein**, and fine wines from the region pairs perfectly with every bite. Don’t forget to try our homemade **Speckknödel**—a savory delicacy you won’t find anywhere else! --- **

Adventure awaits just outside

** The **Wirtshaus zum Griena** is the ideal starting point for exploring the natural wonders of **Tirol**. Lace up your hiking boots and set off on one of the many scenic trails leading to **Nordkette**, where panoramic views of **Innsbruck** and the surrounding Alps will leave you in awe. In winter, the nearby slopes offer world-class skiing and snowboarding, with the **Axamer Lizum** ski area just a short drive away. For those who prefer a more relaxed pace, take a leisurely stroll through the charming streets of **Innsbruck**, or visit the picturesque villages of **St. Sigmund im Sellrain** or **Ellmau**, both renowned for their beauty and hospitality. --- **

Your home away from home

** Whether you're traveling solo, with family, or with friends, the **Wirtshaus zum Griena** promises an unforgettable stay. Our warm and welcoming team is always on hand to ensure your visit is nothing short of perfect. **Come and experience Tirol like never before—where tradition, adventure, and good food come together in perfect harmony.** --- **Plan your visit today**
